FIELDS.NAME: Bistro Delights
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Gourmet Lane, Apt 4B, Food Town, TX 75001-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Bistro Delights operates as a full-service family restaurant focused primarily on providing a warm and inviting dining experience with an emphasis on high-quality food and excellent customer service. Our establishment accommodates up to 150 guests in a cozy environment, ensuring a comfortable dining atmosphere. 

To maintain a safe and compliant operation, we strictly limit our alcohol sales to beer and wine, which constitute no more than 30% of our total revenue, aligning with our food-focused mission. Guests can enjoy their meals with selected beverages in a family-friendly setting, free of cocktail lounges or bar areas.

Our kitchen is equipped with necessary fire suppression and ventilation systems to minimize hazards, particularly from grease-laden vapors produced during cooking. We prioritize food safety and adhere to local health regulations, with ongoing training for staff on proper food handling procedures. 

Bistro Delights operates year-round and effectively manages our supply chain through reliable vendors to ensure the freshest ingredients are consistently available for our diverse menu. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction has resulted in a strong and loyal customer base. All operations are designed to minimize risks while providing exceptional dining experiences to our guests.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 15, 2022, Bistro Delights experienced water damage due to a burst pipe in the kitchen, resulting in repairs costing $8,000. The issue has been resolved, and all necessary repairs were completed by February 15, 2022. Additionally, on September 10, 2022, a slip and fall incident occurred when a customer slipped on a wet floor, leading to a settlement of $7,000. The incident was investigated, and appropriate measures to enhance safety protocols have been implemented. Both claims have been settled and closed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Safe, Class 2, Fire rated, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with round-the-clock monitoring and a perimeter fence.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Bistro Delights does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. The operations focus primarily on food service, and all safety protocols are strictly followed.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Bistro Delights does not sponsor any athletic teams. The focus is solely on providing quality dining experiences to our guests.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by the management or designated staff responsible for compliance and risk management.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Bistro Delights has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. Our operations prioritize compliance and ethical standards.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Bistro Delights has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. All insurance requirements have been consistently maintained.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Bistro Delights does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we maintain our own staff for all operational needs. This approach ensures consistency in service and quality for our guests.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Bistro Delights does not currently carry workers' compensation insurance, but it ensures compliance with legal requirements for employee protection.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Bistro Delights does not own or operate any other business. We focus exclusively on providing high-quality dining experiences at our restaurant.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Bistro Delights does not hold any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All insurance is currently managed under the existing policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Bistro Delights is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations are strictly focused on providing high-quality food service in a full-service family restaurant setting.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Bistro Delights does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations are focused solely on providing an excellent dining experience for our guests. We prioritize maintaining all equipment in-house to ensure quality and safety.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Bistro Delights has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business has maintained financial stability and compliance with its obligations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Bistro Delights does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond standard kitchen operations. Our safety protocols and equipment ensure a secure environment for our dining experience.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Bistro Delights does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations prioritize safety and comply with all regulations, minimizing risks associated with potential catastrophes.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Bistro Delights has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. All operations adhere to strict hiring practices and maintain a safe environment for both staff and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Bistro Delights does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, as we ensure compliance with all fire safety regulations and maintain our fire suppression and ventilation systems regularly.
